Palindrome: Able was I saw Elba - no lemon, no melon

This is an example of a well-known palindrome. Here's a longer one:

"Able was I saw Elba, no lemon, no melon, radar did radar, civic deed civic, level madam level, eye boy boy eye, Eve, Eve."

While this is not a single sentence or phrase but rather a collection of words and phrases that are palindromes when read forward and backward.
